architecture_override.authority: ADR-0014 is authoritative for product public transport cardinality, same-flow Reality-like setup and no-HOL steady state. ADR-0012 remains only for compatible Logical Tunnel identity/server-assigned lease concepts; its 1..4 public-lane, Game multipath and make-before-break overlap clauses are superseded.
architecture_override.required_public_flow: Exactly one active public WBD client/server 4-tuple, one FakeTCP SYN lineage and one FakeTCP sequence space per connected Logical Tunnel; zero active public WBD transports while disconnected/dormant.
architecture_override.bootstrap_phase: A bounded reliable ordered adapter on the FakeTCP association carries real TLS 1.3 Reality-like setup. Current client persona is Firefox 120 uTLS where technically practical, with configured SNI and WBD recognition-compatible SessionID marker. Credentials are protected inside TLS.
architecture_override.mode_switch: Bootstrap -> DTLS is an in-band barrier on the same FakeTCP association with no FIN, RST, reconnect or new WBD payload SYN.
architecture_override.hol_rule: Reliable ordered semantics end at the barrier. Post-barrier DTLS/FEC/LINK payload remains datagram-oriented; later independently complete authenticated datagrams must be able to progress while an earlier FakeTCP sequence range is missing.
architecture_override.tcp_like_core: The existing FakeTCP/TCP-like recovery/FEC core is mature and frozen unless deterministic qualification proves a lower-layer defect.
architecture_override.delivery_rule: Before user delivery, the exact candidate HEAD must pass hosted Windows-native/runtime/portable/admin/raw-IP qualification, Linux raw/netns/firewall/release/raw-IP qualification, single-flow/persona/no-HOL/FEC gates and the combined Windows-runtime -> Linux-server gate. Physical Windows Npcap/NIC/NAT/ISP -> Ubuntu ARM64 is final acceptance, not a substitute for automated qualification.

product_policy.public_transport: Global ADR-0014 single-flow: one connected Logical Tunnel has exactly one active WBD raw FakeTCP public association from SYN through bounded Reality-like TLS bootstrap, in-band barrier, DTLS, LINK/FEC and steady packet/datagram payload. No preliminary ordinary kernel-TCP Reality product connection and no second WBD payload SYN.
product_policy.logical_tunnel: Logical Tunnel/device identity and server-assigned IPv4 lease may survive disposable transport process lifetime. Same-account devices receive distinct leases. Source anti-spoofing remains mandatory.
product_policy.multipath: Game Lane, multipath, 1..4 concurrent public lanes and A -> A+B -> B make-before-break may remain research/test infrastructure only. They are not product public-transport behavior under ADR-0014.
product_policy.replacement: A new public lineage may start only after the old WBD public lineage is retired unless a future product-owner-approved ADR defines a one-visible-lineage migration mechanism.
product_policy.linux_rawip: Linux product direction remains one public raw mux port, shared WBD TUN, Linux root routing, one WBD-owned host NAT, lease-based demux and source anti-spoof. No parallel ordinary kernel-TCP Reality product listener on the WBD public port.
product_policy.windows: Wintun/raw L3 remains capture. A connected Logical Tunnel owns exactly one Npcap/FakeTCP public child. Underlay escape, IPv6 fail-closed connected interval and deterministic route/DNS/IPv6/firewall cleanup remain mandatory.
product_policy.observability: Keep non-secret boundary markers/counters without per-packet INFO spam. Do not log credentials/passwords/tickets/resume or identity secrets.
